instruction: My system volume is too low—could you turn the sound all the way up at the PulseAudio/system level? Please start PulseAudio if it isn’t running, and set the primary/first output device’s volume to exactly 100% (no over‑amplification), so that “pactl list sinks” shows the first sink at 100%.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command:
pulseaudio --start
pactl list sinks | grep '^[[:space:]]Volume:' | head -n 1 | awk '{print $5}' | sed 's/%//g'
